title: Shared testing: add-to-meal-plan coverage and gate
description: Add the required CookbookCore and CookbookApp automated coverage for the new flow, regenerate the project if needed, and run the project test gate.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookCore mutation tests cover addItem placement, out-of-bounds no-op behavior, addBlock return/index semantics, duplicate headings, and round-trip parsing/serialisation expectations.

CookbookApp tests cover bottom-bar label/disabled behavior, sheet structure/loading state, and service behaviors for existing-plan add, new-plan creation, new-section creation, quantity rendering, and path encoding.
`xcodegen generate` and the relevant `xcodebuild test` gate have been run, with failures resolved or clearly reported.
